import argparse
from hashlib import sha256
from itertools import product
import json
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree


PAIRINGS = {"training": (40, 0), "heldout": (42, 4)}
SHELL = 1.30
MOBILITY = 0.00022797992459479204


def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_bytes())


def digest(raw):
    return sha256(raw).hexdigest()


def source(base, history):
    name = f"id{history}_zero"
    raw = (base / "runs" / (name + ".json")).read_bytes()
    checksum = digest(raw)
    assert checksum == read(base / "ZERO_RUNS.json")["results"][name]
    run = json.loads(raw)
    assert (run["history"], run["strain"], run["pressure_external"], run["temperature"]) == (history, 0, 0, 1.088)
    return run, checksum


def face_frame(box):
    """Minimal proper rotation on column vectors that brings the face normal to +w."""
    w = np.eye(4)[3]
    n = np.linalg.solve(box, w)
    n /= np.linalg.norm(n)
    if n @ w < 0:
        raise ValueError("Native cell points away from the specified interface normal")
    skew = np.outer(w, n) - np.outer(n, w)
    rotation = np.eye(4) + skew + (skew @ skew) / (1. + n @ w)
    oriented = box @ rotation.T
    np.testing.assert_allclose(oriented[:3, 3], 0, atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(rotation @ rotation.T, np.eye(4), atol=2e-12)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.linalg.det(rotation), 1.)
    oriented[:3, 3] = 0.
    return n, oriented


def local_order(state):
    """Return each site's mean pairwise U6(cos(angle))/7 over its distinct shell bonds."""
    box = np.asarray(state["box"])
    pos = np.asarray(state["pos"])
    inv = np.linalg.inv(box)
    x = ((pos @ inv) % 1.) @ box
    # Central cell to all images within the cutoff. The face spacing bounds each fractional offset.
    extents = np.ceil(1. + SHELL * np.linalg.norm(inv, axis=0)).astype(int) - 1
    shifts = np.array(list(product(*(range(-k, k+1) for k in extents)))) @ box
    cloud = (x[None, :, :] + shifts[:, None, :]).reshape(-1, 4)
    neighbors = cKDTree(cloud).query_ball_point(x, SHELL)
    out = np.full(len(x), np.nan)
    for i, indices in enumerate(neighbors):
        bonds = cloud[indices] - x[i]
        radii = np.linalg.norm(bonds, axis=1)
        mask = (radii > 1e-10) & (radii < SHELL)
        unit = bonds[mask] / radii[mask, None]
        if len(unit) >= 2:
            cos2 = np.clip(unit @ unit.T, -1., 1.) ** 2
            kernel = ((64.*cos2 - 80.)*cos2 + 24.)*cos2 - 1.
            np.fill_diagonal(kernel, 0.)
            out[i] = kernel.sum() / (7. * len(unit) * (len(unit)-1))
    return out


def reference(base, output):
    result = {}
    for i in (40, 0, 1, 2, 42, 4):
        run, checksum = source(base, i)
        rows = []
        for block in run["blocks"]:
            score = local_order(block["state"])
            if not np.isfinite(score).all():
                raise ValueError(f"Unclassifiable shell in homogeneous preparation {i}")
            rows.append({"mean": float(score.mean()), "site_quantiles": np.quantile(score, [.1, .5, .9]).tolist()})
        box = np.asarray(run["final"]["box"])
        normal, oriented = face_frame(box)
        tensor = np.average([b["mean"]["stress_tensile"] for b in run["blocks"][-4:]], axis=0,
                            weights=[b["steps"] for b in run["blocks"][-4:]])
        result[i] = dict(sha256=checksum, face_normal=normal.tolist(), face_height=float(oriented[3, 3]),
                         pressure_on_native_face=float(-normal @ tensor @ normal),
                         tangent_traction_norm=float(np.linalg.norm(tensor @ normal-(normal @ tensor @ normal)*normal)),
                         face_traction_vector=(tensor @ normal).tolist(), mark6=rows)
    def means(i):
        return [r["mean"] for r in result[i]["mark6"]]
    crystal, receiver = np.mean(means(40)), np.mean(means(0))
    threshold = float((crystal+receiver)/2.)
    direction = np.sign(crystal-receiver)
    passed = all(min(direction*(np.array(means(h))-threshold)) > 0 for h in (40,42))
    passed &= all(max(direction*(np.array(means(h))-threshold)) < 0 for h in (0,1,2,4))
    summary = {"training_midpoint": threshold, "ordered_increasing": bool(direction>0),
               "separates_all_homogeneous_snapshot_means": bool(passed), "case": result}
    output.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+"\n")
    for h in result:
        print(f"history {h}, 16 snapshot shell means {min(means(h)):.6f} to {max(means(h)):.6f}, "
              f"Pnn {result[h]['pressure_on_native_face']:.6f}, tangent traction norm {result[h]['tangent_traction_norm']:.6f}")
    print(f"training midpoint {threshold:.7f}, all snapshots separated {passed}")


def write_input(path, box, pos, label, info):
    payload = json.dumps(info, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False).encode()
    family = digest(payload)
    assert len(label) == len(pos) and np.all((label == 0) | (label == 1))
    with path.open("x") as f:
        f.write(f"{len(pos)} 1.088 {MOBILITY:.17g} {family}\n")
        np.savetxt(f, np.vstack((box, np.linalg.inv(box), pos)), fmt="%.17g")
        np.savetxt(f, label, fmt="%d")
    path.with_suffix(path.suffix+".json").write_bytes(payload + b"\n")


def prepare(base, output, case, material):
    crystal, receiver = PAIRINGS[case]
    h = crystal if material == "ordered" else receiver
    ref, cref = source(base, crystal)
    run, parent = source(base, h)
    native = np.asarray(run["final"]["box"])
    normal, oriented = face_frame(native)
    area = face_frame(np.asarray(ref["final"]["box"]))[1][:3,:3]
    common = oriented.copy()
    common[:3,:3] = area
    common[3,3] = np.linalg.det(native) / np.linalg.det(area)
    np.testing.assert_allclose(np.linalg.det(common), np.linalg.det(native))
    # Logarithmic fit strain after a proper rotation of the source, at fixed constituent density.
    singular = np.linalg.svd(np.linalg.solve(oriented, common), compute_uv=False)
    pos = ((np.asarray(run["final"]["pos"]) @ np.linalg.inv(native)) % 1.) @ common
    info = dict(case=case, material=material, source=parent, history=h, reference=cref,
                tangent_vectors=area.tolist(), original_face_normal=normal.tolist(),
                input_face_height=float(common[3,3]), native_face_height=float(oriented[3,3]),
                fit_principal_stretches=singular.tolist(), native_to_common_volume_ratio=float(np.linalg.det(common)/np.linalg.det(native)))
    write_input(output, common, pos, np.full(len(pos), int(material == "receiver")), info)
    print(json.dumps(info, allow_nan=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="task", required=True)
    for task in ("parents", "prepare"):
        item = sub.add_parser(task)
        item.add_argument("base", type=Path)
        item.add_argument("output", type=Path)
        if task == "prepare":
            item.add_argument("--case", required=True, choices=PAIRINGS)
            item.add_argument("--material", required=True, choices=("ordered", "receiver"))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.task == "parents":
        reference(args.base, args.output)
    else:
        prepare(args.base, args.output, args.case, args.material)

    t=np.clip((r-2.25)/.25,0,1); switch=1-10*t**3+15*t**4-6*t**5; ds=-120*t*t*(1-t)**2
    return base*switch, derivative*switch+base*ds

def direct(x,v,box):

    n=len(x); centre=x@np.linalg.inv(box);i,j=np.triu_indices(n,1)
    # Every pair is counted exactly once per image. Unwrap a skew cell in fractional coordinates.
    delta=centre[j]-centre[i];delta-=np.rint(delta)

    extent=np.floor(reciprocal_width+.5+1e-12).astype(int)
    energy=0.; gradient=np.zeros((4,4))
    for raw in product(*(range(-s,s+1) for s in extent)):
        tile=np.array(raw)
        d=(delta+tile)@box;r2=np.einsum('ij,ij->i',d,d); use=r2<2.5**2
        r=np.sqrt(r2[use]);sub=d[use];u,du=morse(r);energy+=u.sum();gradient+=sub.T@((du/r)[:,None]*sub)
        if raw>(0,0,0,0):

            if rs<2.5:
                u,du=morse(rs);energy+=n*u;gradient+=n*(du/rs)*np.outer(self_image,self_image)
    return float(energy),(gradient-v.T@v)/np.linalg.det(box)

reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the four independent homogeneous common-face coupons, the fixed tangential lattice and volume-preserving initial map, and the unforced log-height/physical-slide dynamics and whole-cell traction used for the neutral preflight. Phase survival, common-traction conditioning and conversion at a mobile junction remain experimental questions.

reviews.scope: Common-face static geometry, preparation energies and homogeneous spatial windows
reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the reported native-face loads, affine preparation work and the separation of homogeneous parent material in 768 overlapping one-bond-thick windows. The local marker does not establish conversion of any individual constituent or compatibility at a joined interface.

reviews.scope: Saved fit energy and settling heat for six receiver histories
reviews.verdict: Verified both energy statements from the six receiver histories in the reconciled manifest and the independent geometry record. The affine potential increments per site were +1.7541859539854157 and +9.79628944825663. For the subsequent 48.881712431228657-unit settling interval, raw warm_bath_heat ranges were −295.18836406711864 to −247.97036665899532 (receiver A) and −1191.1557563117906 to −1182.6277481019947 (receiver 41), all n=128. C++ accumulates the thermostat’s kinetic-energy change into the sample and accepted cell moves’ potential changes separately. Positive heat-removal magnitudes round exactly as proposed. No throat conversion was observed and the data do not identify the density dip’s cause. Existing scoped verdict stands.

reviews.scope: Late structural observations, paired traction uncertainty and the conditional gradual-fit decision
reviews.verdict: No sampled order loss or fragmentation, so no demonstrated phase loss to trigger a gradual-fit rescue; density persistence genuinely failed for that history.

design.physical_scope: Neutral 128-site four-periodic homogeneous preparations only; common tangent face, three normal-row shear slides and one log-normal height free; full normal-face pressure vector has an explicit zero target, no fixed sites. Local axes rotate original material cells to the new normal. Stress and shear history of this coupon are independent of the earlier lab xw receiver test. No junction or mouth yet.
design.preparation: Abrupt volume-preserving common-face fit of each receiver source and no strain at its ordered comparator, independent thermal realizations at T1.088. Common random seeds pair each ordered and receiver comparison. Source geometry and ordinary-site histories are not independent repeats across replications; only two original comparisons. The preparation deposits 1.75419 or 9.79629 potential energy/site and may disturb the receiver. A failed fit needs a gradual-fit control to assess relaxation. Distinguish warm from measurement energy residual. Source state 840-native transit is separate from present 48.88171243122866 + 48.88171243122866 native units. No physical mouth time calibration.
design.tests: Order and mobile-receiver criteria at 8 late endpoints with dense connected material, finite density drift, local and four-dimensional diffraction plus receiver neighbor exchange and nonaffine motion. Report all 4 pressure components, conditional marginal 95% t intervals for each group and paired preparation at three common-seed realizations with an operational equivalence margin of ±0.25. Passing these homogeneous checks enables discussion of an unbiased fully mobile joined-cell experiment; no automatic production.
design.controls: Shape work virtual derivatives, stress, gradient and forward/reverse log ratio are independently checked. Finite 8-time instrument trial at dt=.004 and .002, 32 local balance cells; seeded ensemble is distinct. dt=.002 gives energy residual -.02697054655/site in severe fast fit vs -.11524665596/site at .004. Fixed cell move cadence .08, no deadlines.
